articles.summary: PEMBROKE, BERMUDA, January 12, 2026 — Hamilton Insurance Group, Ltd. (NYSE: HG) (“Hamilton” or the “Company”) announced today the appointment of Susan Steinhoff as Chief Underwriting Officer at Hamilton Re, the Company’s Bermuda-based insurance and reinsurance underwriting platform. Steinhoff brings over 25 years of insurance industry experience, having held senior roles at ACE (now Chubb) and joining Hamilton in its early days in 2014.
